task_1.title: Drain decoder buffers for chunked responses
task_1.description: urllib3 2.6.2 fixes compressed chunked response reading so HTTPResponse.read_chunked() accounts for data already buffered inside the content decoder before it reads more bytes from the chunked body. This prevents decoding failures for large brotli-compressed chunked responses delivered in small network segments and preserves successful decompression of the response body.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that compressed responses read through chunked transfer handling continue draining any pending decoder output before accepting more chunk bytes, so valid compressed chunked responses do not fail during decompression.

expectation.grounded: HTTPResponse.read_chunked() must check an active content decoder for unconsumed buffered data before advancing chunk parsing. When the decoder reports pending buffered data, read_chunked() should invoke the normal decode path without reading another chunk first, allowing encodings such as br to yield remaining decompressed bytes without raising DecodeError for otherwise valid chunked responses.
expectation.conceptual: Reading a valid compressed chunked response should transparently return the full decompressed body, even when the decoder has already received compressed bytes but still has decompressed output pending. The caller should not see a decompression failure caused only by chunked reads advancing before the decoder buffer is drained.

constraints.grounded: The change must preserve existing HTTPResponse.read_chunked() semantics for uncompressed responses, responses without an initialized decoder, decoders without buffered data, normal chunk length updates, end-of-chunk detection, decode_content handling, and exceptions for genuinely invalid compressed content.
constraints.conceptual: Do not change successful streaming behavior or hide real decoding errors. Only valid compressed chunked responses with pending decoder output should gain reliability.

behavior: HTTPResponse.read_chunked() drains an active decoder's unconsumed buffered data before reading or parsing the next chunk from the underlying response.
When decoder buffered data exists, the chunked reader passes no new network bytes into the decode path and lets the decoder emit pending decompressed output.

Large brotli-compressed responses using Transfer-Encoding: chunked can be read successfully even when compressed bytes arrive in small segments and the brotli decoder temporarily cannot accept more input.
The fix avoids DecodeError conditions caused by feeding additional compressed bytes while the decoder still has buffered data to process.
Chunk length parsing and chunk consumption continue unchanged once the decoder no longer has buffered data pending.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid brotli-compressed HTTP response with Transfer-Encoding: chunked, when the body is read through HTTPResponse.read_chunked() with content decoding enabled and the decoder has pending buffered data, then the response body should be yielded as decompressed bytes without a DecodeError caused by premature additional input.
When an active content decoder reports unconsumed buffered data during chunked reading, it should be drained before the reader advances to the next chunk length or consumes more chunk bytes.
When no decoder is active or the decoder has no buffered data pending, chunked reading should continue to update chunk lengths, read chunks, and terminate at the final chunk as before.
When compressed chunked content is genuinely invalid, the appropriate decoding error behavior should remain observable.
